meaning.en: Of or pertaining to something which burns more slowly than comparable objects.

sentences.en: These produce slow burning carbohydrates that encourage the body to produce serotonin, the happy hormone.

sentences.en: Soy candles are slow burning and can be very long lasting.

sentences.en: Add a truly unique and exotic touch with oil candle making, whether you are crafting hand blown glass oil candles, oil lamps or simple bowls with slow burning wicks in a puddle of oil.

sentences.en: The carbohydrates in the bread are of a more slow burning type that don't cause large spikes in blood sugar.

sentences.en: Most legumes are high in starch, however, it is a slow burning starch which has less impact on blood sugar and insulin.
sentences.vi: Hầu hết các loại đậu đều chứa nhiều tinh bột, tuy nhiên, nó là loại tinh bột đốt cháy chậm nên ít ảnh hưởng đến lượng đường trong máu và insulin.
